headline: Growth outperformance sustaining; positive start of 2HFY27

India’s revenue grew 32% YoY, supported by healthy SSSG of 20% (South: 19%; non-South: 21%).
Importantly, management indicated that 2Q witnessed volume growth, as SSSG of ~20% came against single-digit gold price inflation.

This reinforces the underlying demand strength and management's confidence in achieving its FY27 growth aspiration of minimum 25% revenue growth.  Post adjustment of inventory gains/losses, GM contracted 80bp YoY to 11.9% and EBITDA margin contracted 20bp to 5.8%.

Kalyan Jewellers 11 November 2026 3 Valuation and view  We maintain our EPS estimates for FY27 and FY28.  Kalyan has fully repaid its non-GML debt in India during 2QFY27, in line with management's earlier guidance.
watch: Sustained customer acquisition, volume-led demand growth, and the ongoing shift from unorganized to organized retail remain key growth drivers.
Key takeaways from the management commentary  3Q has started on a strong note.
